function.name: get_city_insight
function.description: Fetch condensed, area-level living-suitability data for ONE location (a Spanish city/town/district or coordinate, plus served neighbours) from Parcelabot's parcel-level report database. Returns scored Markdown as INPUT DATA to reason over, never a ready-made verdict. English only; call twice to compare two places.

location.description: A place name in English, or coordinates as "lat,lng". One location per call.

pricing.description: Optional price tier to match like-for-like.
